records.rationale: Introduce the documented threat model as an initial controlled boundary.
alternatives: Defer the initial threat model

records.rationale: Introduce a bounded server-side audit evidence service with closed records, independently sampled integrity proof, accountable privileged reads and an injected private custody boundary. Durable custody, incident lifecycle and independently anchored acceptance require verified adapters.
alternatives: Defer the API-side model until the custody adapters are available.

records.rationale: Expose the audit evidence model from the API package so authorized server-side consumers can integrate it. This entry point adds no network route or initialized adapter.
alternatives: Require server consumers to import the internal module path.

records.rationale: Define a bounded browser-compatible import validation and inert text projection seam. Link metadata uses exact HTTPS policy and asset references are opaque. Actual import authorization, database access and deployed policy require verified consumers.
alternatives: Defer reusable validation until a consumer is available.

records.rationale: Expose the bounded parser and inert text projection through the public canvas package module.
alternatives: Require consumers to use an internal module path.

records.rationale: Define bounded deletion record, transition and independently verified restore-release decisions behind a trusted authority and marker evidence boundary. Actual retention schedules, storage mutation and atomic fencing require approved adapters.
alternatives: Defer the server decision seam until adapters are verified.

records.rationale: Expose deletion decision types and pure checks to approved server consumers.
alternatives: Defer the server decision seam until adapters are verified.

records.rationale: Introduce bounded server-side resource decisions over an approved profile and current scoped accounting. Consumers retain authoritative measurements, serialization and effects.
alternatives: Defer the resource decision seam until ingress and queue adapters are available.

records.rationale: Expose the resource decision boundary and its input and result contracts to server-side consumers.
alternatives: Defer the resource decision seam until ingress and queue adapters are available.

records.rationale: Publish bounded canonical asset bytes in a trusted private Linux directory. A same-directory hard link provides atomic no-clobber installation; file and directory sync gate success and verified retries. A failed attempt can leave private unreferenced bytes for later fenced reconciliation.
alternatives: An ordinary rename can replace an existing immutable object. Writing directly to the final name exposes completion races.

records.rationale: Expose the private filesystem publication interface to trusted API consumers before application reference publication.
alternatives: Keep the module internal to its source path until a consumer integrates it.

records.rationale: Describe tenant-safe isolated migration, exact supported engines and the verified recovery boundary.
alternatives: Retain the empty database scaffold until a supported exact-schema and interruption fixture is available.

records.rationale: Install the accepted T5 v1 relations with scoped InnoDB keys and hard references.
alternatives: Retain the empty database scaffold until a supported exact-schema and interruption fixture is available.

records.rationale: Verify the exact catalog and generation before installing or resuming a bounded initial migration.
alternatives: Retain the empty database scaffold until a supported exact-schema and interruption fixture is available.

records.rationale: Provide closed operational log and error records with bounded, expiring, server-issued scoped correlation.
alternatives: Keep structured log consumers unavailable until a live exporter and retention policy are approved.

records.rationale: Expose the validated operational log boundary through the server API workspace entry.
alternatives: Keep structured log consumers unavailable until a live exporter and retention policy are approved.

records.rationale: Validate the fixed metric registry, finite dimensions and immutable approved histogram layouts.
alternatives: Keep metric validation unavailable until the approved runtime signals and collector are wired.

records.rationale: Expose the bounded metric validation boundary for future authorized server telemetry consumers.
alternatives: Keep metric validation unavailable until the approved runtime signals and collector are wired.

records.rationale: Stop admission and coordinate bounded drain, reconnect and telemetry callbacks without changing durable release authority.
alternatives: Defer reusable shutdown coordination until an approved runtime and supervisor integration exists.

records.rationale: Expose the process-local shutdown coordinator through the public server API workspace.
alternatives: Defer reusable shutdown coordination until an approved runtime and supervisor integration exists.
